bugs.evidence: Browser check created a unique 3x purchase and verified its installment row, but the dashboard assertion for the first monthly installment was not found after returning to the dashboard. The created purchase used the default current date; with the seeded card closing day 15, its first invoice is the next month, while the dashboard remained on the current month. This indicates the check flow needs to select the calculated invoice month before asserting consolidation; no API failure was involved.
